No boot-path touchpoint changes a binary's start; `host_log`, `mcp_log`, `mcp_server` and `cli_commands` drive both roles and stand in for the smoke. Fired on the blitz-tests   entry, case: step 9's `select_popup` tree test. - **A move marks nothing.** In `document.rs` `move_select_list_current`, delete the `changed_nodes` insert. Fired on   the blitz-tests entry, case `the_keys_move_the_highlight_over_enabled_rows_and_choose_nothing`. - **Cells states nothing.** In `cells.rs`, delete the `aria_selected` line. Fired on the blitz-tests entry, case:   step 9's `stand_cells_served` test.

prose.text: The gates: - the unit tests of the four touched library crates; - the blitz-tests targets the steps write, plus their companions: the snapshot's text, parts and diff checks, the   keyboard walk, the tree-state checks, contrast, select interaction, the MCP listing and the replay; - seven_guis' process checks; - the capability-statement pin; - the a11y leg (`stand_keyboard`, `select_interaction` and `accessibility_active_descendant_unread` are in it); - the pre-push gate (`fast`); the `doc` leg, because public doc comments change (`NodeState`, `Reading`,   `Harness::highlight_contrast`, the `NODE_FIELDS` help) and `fast` runs no rustdoc; - `stand-repeat`.

No boot-path touchpoint changes a binary's start; `host_log`, `mcp_log`, `mcp_server` and `cli_commands` drive both roles and stand in for the smoke. There is no live leg; the cold-agent pipe is not run. Its `list_opens` counter reads rows whose `differs` is exactly `bounds`. An opening still moves every other row by `bounds` alone, so it is unaffected, and its contract tests run in `fast`'s CI-scripts step.

Each new check is controlled red-before-green (tests S4). After the steps are green, /implement makes five one-shot `gate.py control` runs, never entries: - **The painted read removed.** In `lint.rs`, delete the `highlight_contrast` call so only `text_contrast` is read.   Fired on the blitz-tests entry, case: step 9's `stand_lint` test. - **The row height from the select again.** In `document.rs` `measure_select_list`, return the select's own line   height alone. Fired on the blitz-tests entry, case: step 9's `select_popup` row-height test. - **No active descendant.** In `accessibility.rs`, delete the `set_active_descendant` call. Fired on the blitz-tests   entry, case: step 9's `select_popup` tree test. - **A move marks nothing.** In `document.rs` `move_select_list_current`, delete the `changed_nodes` insert. Fired on   the blitz-tests entry, case `the_keys_move_the_highlight_over_enabled_rows_and_choose_nothing`. - **Cells states nothing.** In `cells.rs`, delete the `aria_selected` line. Fired on the blitz-tests entry, case:   step 9's `stand_cells_served` test.
Each control names the edit's text and the case by its test name, with `--no-fail-fast` reaching it (gate-contract.md §Control).

An acceptance reads CI: the windows and macOS legs of `matrix_test` hold the re-read Cells digests. So the operator's hygiene, push and CI entries stand. The diff is OS-sensitive only through those digests; no `cfg` site is added or changed.
